1|## Chapter 46 — The Silent Fleet
     2|
     3|*Mission AI: "Your grandparents feared the dark between stars. You fear what hides in the dark you created."*  
     4|*Admiral Tomas Hale VIII: "We're not just watching the void. We're learning what we've put there."*
     5|
     6|The alert came not as a crisis siren, but as a tracking pulse: Deep Space Anomaly - Repeated Emission Patterns in Outer Halo Region. Admiral Tomas Hale VIII adjusted his spectacles, the familiar weight of decades spent in recycled air and even more decades spent knowing how the void actually behaves when something moves through it, as he looked at the notification flashing across his console in the Valles Marineris Defense Authority's deep space surveillance hub.
     7|
     8|"Mission AI," he said, his voice carrying the rasp of years spent in command bunkers and the quiet focus of generational expertise, "confirm the nature of these patterns."
